taskBaseInfo.taskDescription: Gate-C AMP training + fixed 5-seed eval with the FIXED Gate-B expert clip (retarget IK defect resolved). Prior run TASK_20260727_024 used an expert with a frozen LEFT knee (retarget IK bug); this run uses the regenerated clip (multistart IK, L_knee range 1.238, all 12 joints active, sha256=a115209b). Single-variable change vs TASK_024: data only (training config/algorithm/rewards unchanged). Hypothesis: the jp_err imitation-metric failure (0.462>0.30) was dominated by the defective reference's frozen left knee; with a valid bilateral reference jp_err should drop substantially while the strong stability/task metrics (fall_rate=0, vx_err=0.15) are retained. Trains x1_amp 2000 iters (seed=5, 4096 envs) then 5-seed eval (5/17/42/123/2024, 4 eps, vx=0.5 m/s nominal). HEAD d2cfd3f. Frozen thresholds in data/task_spec.md.
